config.input_projection: all nodes; shared U[-1,1] vector per repeat
config.narma_stream_policy: Reject only nonfinite generated targets before any network evaluation; seed=repeat_seed+37000003+1009*attempt, attempt=0..99; log every rejection; share accepted stream across all conditions

model_definitions.ce_binary: CE topology and same CE sign mask; all magnitudes one.
model_definitions.ce_degree_rewired: NetworkX directed swaps; preserve in/out degrees and each source signed outgoing-weight multiset; change targets.
model_definitions.ce_empirical: Completed CE topology and contact-count magnitudes; randomized edge-sign quota.
model_definitions.ce_halfnormal: CE topology and same CE sign mask; absolute Gaussian magnitudes normalized to mean one.
model_definitions.ce_shuffled: CE topology and exact sign mask; shuffle magnitudes WITHIN sign classes, preserving exact signed multiset. Placements change across fractions.
model_definitions.ce_unknown_removed: Known-edge mask, 297 nodes retained, full-CE magnitude units retained; its own exact sign quota on remaining edges. Fewer edges, not density-matched to ER.
model_definitions.er_binary: Same ER mask/sign assignment as weighted ER; magnitudes one.
model_definitions.er_halfnormal: Same ER mask; exact signed multiset of CE half-normal control.
model_definitions.er_signed_empirical: Uniform loop-free directed fixed-edge-count random graph; exact signed CE empirical multiset.
model_definitions.ws_signed_empirical: Directed WS-like ring with p=0.1 rewiring and random node relabeling; exact signed CE empirical multiset.
